segments.en: One should not eat, drink, or speak before prayer. Even essential speech should be as brief as possible — and through this one's prayer will be acceptable. For one must invest all one's strength and kavvanah in the words of prayer — and therefore one must not weaken or interrupt the yearnings of the soul that longs to pour out its speech before its Creator.
